title: DataPass MosaicStudio stack
subtitle: Python computes, artifacts carry the result, Studio clients render it as static sites.
note: DOCUMENTED from repository files (see each node). Python bridge, service and file watch are prototype branches; no deployment, authentication or hosting provider is implied.

layers.label: Repository & files
layers.description: Source of truth: the git repository and the artifact JSON files producers write beside each client.

layers.label: Python producers
layers.description: Any Python code computes: plain scripts, Jupyter, marimo. All of them write the same artifact contract.

layers.label: Live services
layers.description: Optional on-demand paths for local authoring: a FastAPI compute service and a dev-server file watch.

layers.label: Studio clients
layers.description: TypeScript framework and the client pages that validate and render artifacts. The browser never runs a calculation.

layers.label: Build & CI
layers.description: One client per static bundle, gated by GitHub Actions.

layers.label: People
layers.description: Who runs producers and who reads the pages.

domains.label: Python side
domains.description: Producers and the local compute service (py/).

domains.label: Repository & CI
domains.description: GitHub repository, workflow gate and static bundles.

nodes.label: Artifact files
nodes.description: datapass.artifact v1 JSON written to clients/<id>/public/artifacts with a manifest. Bounded: ≤ 10 000 rows, ≤ 40 columns, 1 MB. Optional Parquet sidecar for other tools; the page never reads it.

nodes.label: Git repository
nodes.description: datapass-mosaicstudio on GitHub. One branch per package; pull requests merge on green CI.

nodes.label: Wind model script
nodes.description: Plain Python script: an illustrative Weibull AEP table (generic power curve, k = 2, no losses).

nodes.label: Jupyter & marimo
nodes.description: The same model called from one notebook cell (Jupyter) or a slider app (marimo).

nodes.label: Artifact writer
nodes.description: Standard-library helper to_artifact / write_manifest. Enforces ids, provenance and size limits early; atomic writes.

nodes.label: FastAPI service
nodes.description: Prototype on 127.0.0.1:8765: GET /health, GET /artifacts/{id}, POST /compute/wind-reference. Same artifact contract; runId = hash of model version + inputs. Loopback only, no authentication.

nodes.label: Artifact file watch
nodes.description: Dev-only Vite plugin: watches public/artifacts, dedupes by sha256 and pushes datapass:artifact-changed so pages refetch.

nodes.label: Studio framework
nodes.description: src/framework: runtime, view state, blocks, renderers and ArtifactSource, which re-validates every artifact before rendering.

nodes.label: Wind reference page
nodes.description: Client page with static, live-service and live-file modes over the same artifact.

nodes.label: Architecture atlas
nodes.description: This client: one architecture spec rendered as a layered 3D atlas and static 2D diagrams.

nodes.label: Client build
nodes.description: npm run build:client -- <id> emits dist-clients/<id>: one client, its artifacts, a CSP _headers file and studio-build.json evidence.

nodes.label: Studio web gate
nodes.description: GitHub Actions on ubuntu-latest: unit tests, build, browser tests and selected-client builds on every push and PR.

nodes.label: Static bundle
nodes.description: Any static host can serve dist-clients/<id>. Built pages keep connect-src self, so they show static artifacts unless a deployment allows a service origin.

nodes.label: Author
nodes.description: Runs producers locally and previews pages with npm run client:dev.

nodes.label: Page visitor
nodes.description: Opens the static page in a browser; artifacts load same-origin and are validated client-side.
